{{short description|Ukrainian mathematician}}
{{distinguish|text=Belarusian swimmer [[Mariya Shcherba]]}}
'''Mariya Vladimirovna Shcherbyna''' ({{langx|uk|Марія Володимирівна Щербина}}, born December 11, 1958) is a Ukrainian mathematician and mathematical physicist who studies the [[random matrix|theory of random matrices]].{{r|cv}} She is a corresponding member of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]], and the 2009 winner of the Mikhail Vasilyevich Ostrogradsky Prize.{{r|nasua}}

Shcherbina earned a diploma from the [[National University of Kharkiv]] in 1981, and then did graduate studies at the [[Verkin Institute for Low Temperature Physics and Engineering]], earning a [[Candidate of Sciences|candidacy]] in 1986. She completed her [[habilitation]] at the institute in 1997. She has been employed as a researcher at the Verkin Institute since 1983, and is a division head there.{{r|cv}}

With Leonid Pastur, Shcherbina is the author of ''Eigenvalue Distribution of Large Random Matrices'' (Mathematical Surveys and Monographs, American Mathematical Society, 2011).{{r|edlmr}}
She was an invited speaker on mathematical physics at the 2018 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].{{r|icm}}
